content.text: {"label":"marketing_campaign","explanation":"General is running 30-53% above forecast since 09:30 (+46% in the latest alert). SL dipped to 68% at 09:45 and was 83.5% at 10:00. The excess is concentrated in loan_enquiry (2.29x normal, +52 calls) and new_offer_enquiry (3.53x, +36 calls). That matches the pre-approved personal loan email (MKT-2026-551) sent at 09:00 to 900k customers with a 'Call us to activate' call-to-action. Supply looks normal: absences are at or below usual, agents are on phones roughly as planned, and general AHT is near forecast. There are no incidents. Payments is on forecast at about 99% SL. The 10:40 newsletter has no call-to-action and should add little load.","plan_name":"Absorb loan-campaign surge on general","rationale":"About 30 extra calls per 15 minutes at roughly 350 s AHT needs about 11-12 extra agents on general for the next few hours, until the email response decays. The plan stacks levers in order of cost: (1) Move 5 cross-skilled agents from payments, which is free. Payments has 34 agents at 99% SL, so 5 is well under the 30% cap and payments should stay above 70% SL. (2) Delay general breaks in the next hour by 30 minutes, which is free and borrows capacity for the peak. (3) Deflect up to 20% of new_offer_enquiry calls to chat at Rs 12 per chat. (4) Offer overtime to 10 general agents for 10:45-12:45. About 4 should accept, costing roughly Rs 2,900, well within budget. (5) A callback safety net is turned on during the peak so no caller waits more than 120 s without an offer. The outage message is not used because there is no outage.
